skills.purpose: Keep a task list that survives sessions: add tasks, see what is next, mark progress, hand off to the next session.
Stop at human decision gates in an agentic build: starting a feature, approving a plan, judging a test, shipping.
Plan and review while outside coding agents (Codex, Gemini, cloud) implement. Use when coordinating workers on one repo.
Repair garbled or dictated messages (speech-to-text, autocorrect, typos, fillers) and read back before acting.
Use when writing error handling, fallbacks or retries, or when repeated attempts keep failing without new evidence.
Read and honor TypeSafe Jev routing. Use at the start of a multi-step task and on JEV route:, DECISIONS: and RULE lines.
List other live Claude Code sessions, message one, or debate with another agent through a shared file.
Use when a command or tool keeps failing or a fix comes from memory. Looks up current dated sources before patching.
Use when producing a doc, plan, spec, PRD or tooling. Stops invented process, gates and reviews nobody asked for.
Capture requirements at the start of a coding task and compare built work against them before saying done.
Use for any bug, test failure, build failure or unexpected behaviour, before proposing a fix. Find the root cause first.
5-gate audit for L2+ tasks (spec, dry-run, health, verification, handoff). Use before starting and before done.
Use before claiming work is done, fixed, passing or merged, or relaying a subagent's success. Run a command first.
Use when a spec spans several steps, before touching code. Writes a task-by-task plan another agent can execute.
